==Description==
'''Birthday''' is a cosmetic [[Modifiers|modifier]] that adds party hats onto every enemy, adds confetti particles when an enemy dies and plays a party horn sound upon death.

'''Birthday''' is active on all maps on the 15th of June to celebrate Tower Defense Simulator's transition from Alpha Testing to BETA, more specifically with the release of the [[BETA v1.0]] update. It was first enabled on all maps on the 15th of June 2023.

==Effects==
When active, the '''Birthday''' modifier will add blue party hats with rainbow dots onto every enemy. Confetti particles accompanied by a party horn sound will be produced upon death. If an enemy has a death animation, the confetti death effect will play after the enemy disappears entirely. It does not override any cosmetic modifiers. Death effects from other modifiers will play alongside the confetti explosion, but the party hat will be replaced by other modifiers' hats. If an enemy has a death sound, the party horn sound does not replace it.

On some enemies like the [[Normal]], the party hat may be much bigger than it should be.

==Trivia==
*This modifier shares its icon with the [[Fireworks]] modifier.
*Weirdly, the modifier becomes active on the 15th of June, despite the game transitioning from Alpha to BETA on the 14th of June.
